text.en:
Upon being struck by a Melee Attack, for 5 seconds:
Grants <pve 75% /> <pvp [50%] /> Increased Melee Damage for one Melee Attack.

Buff duration is not refreshable.

Being struck by a Melee Attack grants <pve 75% /> <pvp [50%] /> increased Melee Damage for your next Melee Attack within 5 seconds.

Buff duration is not refreshable.

Being struck by a Melee Attack grants an additional <pve 100% /> <pvp [50%] /> of your base Melee damage for your next Melee Attack within 5 seconds.

Buff duration is not refreshable.
